title: show failure history
description: Add a button that opens a modal page that shows the failure history in a table with a button that allows to close the modal view and another button that allows to clear the failure history
close_reason: Added failure history modal with table view. Features: History button opens modal showing failed dates with weekday, failure count, and time since last review. Close button and click-outside-modal to close. Clear history button with confirmation dialog. All tests passing (40/40).

title: screen shouldn't sleep when in speech mode
close_reason: Implemented Wake Lock API to prevent screen sleep during voice mode. The screen will now stay awake while the game is in voice mode, ensuring uninterrupted hands-free gameplay. Added comprehensive test coverage with 4 new tests. All 22 tests pass.

title: Persist score in local storage
close_reason: Implemented localStorage-based score persistence. Score and attempts are now saved after each round and restored on page load. Added comprehensive test suite with 5 new tests covering persistence, reload behavior, and error handling. All 18 tests pass.

title: keep track of response times
description: I want to learn not only to be correct but also respons quickly. Please record in local storage histograms of response duration in the buckets of 1s,2s,4s,6s,8s,10s and implement a daily timeseries of such buckets so that we can compute duration percentiles over time; please cap storage for 31 days
notes: Implementation started but encountered issues. Need to debug why app.js changes break existing tests. The feature itself is implemented: tracks response times in buckets (1s,2s,4s,6s,8s,10s), stores daily histograms in localStorage with 31-day rolling window, and includes percentile calculation methods. However, tests are failing - likely due to timing issues with auto-advance feature. Needs further investigation.

title: npm test emits actual sound
description: When I run 'npm test' I can hear synthesised speech. I want to run the same tests but I want you to find a way that the headless browser used for tests doesn't play actual sounds on my laptop!
close_reason: Muted audio playback in Playwright tests by adding '--mute-audio' flag to browser launch options. Tests now run silently without playing synthesized speech through laptop speakers. All 40 tests pass successfully.

title: failure history
description: keep track of 20 most recent failures in local storage and prune them in LRU fashon. Every 4 random dates the game asks it should randomly pick one of the dates from the failure history giving a chance to excercise the dates that are most likely to fail. Basically implement some sort of spaced repetition. You can even implement a proper spaced repetition algorithm. But also include a mix of purely random dates
close_reason: Implemented comprehensive failure history system with spaced repetition algorithm. The system tracks up to 20 most recent failures, uses LRU eviction, and intelligently selects dates for review every 4th round based on failure count and time since last review. All tests passing.
